# iliad-035 — new renderings (rows for the table in conventions.md)

No departure from the Odyssey or from an earlier Iliad row. Reused unchanged: 5.825 (odyssey-065), 5.871 (odyssey-077), 5.821, 5.850, 5.884, 5.891, 5.900, 5.908 (published English kept; the closing ” is dropped where the speech goes on).

| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| τὴν δ’ ἀπαμειβόμενος προσέφη κρατερὸς Διομήδης (5.814, whole-line reply-formula, feminine object) | "Her answering addressed strong Diomedes:" | "In answer strong Diomedes said to her:" | "answered" (reserved for ἠμείβετο), "spoke to her" (kept for the προσέφη rows with a participle of manner, 4.411, 5.286); follows the table’s ἀπαμειβόμενος προσέφη rows and κρατερὸς Διομήδης "strong Diomedes" |
| γιγνώσκω (of a person, 5.815; with a participle, 5.824) | "I recognise" | "I recognise" | "I know" (kept for οἶδα), "I see", "I perceive"; follows ἀνέγνω "recognised" (Odyssey 21.205) |
| ὄκνος (5.817) | "hesitation" | "hesitation" | "reluctance", "shrinking", "fear" (kept for δέος) |
| ἀλήμεναι (5.823; aorist passive infinitive, usually tied to εἴλω "press, crowd") | "to crowd together" | "to crowd together" | "to gather" (loses the press), "to assemble", "to huddle" |
| τυκτὸν κακόν (5.831) | "a fashioned evil" | "a fashioned evil" (+ note: τυκτός "made", meaning here not certain) | "a made thing of mischief", "a contrived plague", "a patched-up evil", "a creature of bad craft" (each decides the open question) |
| ἀλλοπρόσαλλος (5.831 acc., 5.889 voc.) | "side-changing" · "side-changer" | "a changer of sides" · "you changer of sides" | "turncoat", "fickle", "two-faced", "inconstant" (each adds a modern tone or a meaning the word has not been shown to have); built from ἄλλος "other" and πρός "to" |
| στεῦτ’ ἀγορεύων (5.832) | "declared, speaking out" | "declared" | "boasted" (kept for εὐχόμενος), "swore", "vowed"; στεῦται "declares, makes a solemn promise" |
| πρῴην (5.832) | "a while ago" | "only lately" | "formerly", "once", "recently" |

| τῶν δὲ λέλασται (5.834) | "and has forgotten those things" | "and has forgotten all that" (+ note: τῶν is his promises or the Argives; the Greek does not say) | "has forgotten them" (reads as the Trojans), "has forgotten the Argives" (decides the question) |

| φήγινος ἄξων (5.838) | "oaken axle" | "oaken axle" (+ note: φηγός is an oak, not the beech of the English name) | "beech axle", "axle of beech", "wooden axle" |
